messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — ran a micro shadow cohort for entropy-gated speculative decode on the new quant-7b-cand (4-bit QAT). Ran 10k evals (openwebtext-ish + heldout QA) across vcpu-hosted nodes.

Sara: nice. what's the high-level? latency & quality?

Morgan: p50 token latency down ~18% vs baseline (full decode) on 2048 context, p95 -10%. Throughput up ~22%. cost/token ~-15% estimated. quality: LAMBADA acc -0.6% absolute, MMLU microtopics stable, QA F1 -0.3. minimal hallucination uptick in long-form (>512 tokens)

Jun: can you paste the run command and the gating rule?

Morgan: sure:
```
./run_spec_shadow --model quant-7b-cand --spec-gate entropy --gate-thresh 2.1 --fallback-policy per-token --cohort-size 3 --seed 42 --evalset mini-10k
```
Gating: compute token entropy from top-K (K=32) softmax; if entropy < 2.1 -> speculative step allowed for next N=2 tokens; else fallback to full decode. Fallbacks stitch using kv-cache rollover.

Eli: stitching gotchas? any misalignment artifacts?

Morgan: observed rare token duplication on segment boundaries (~0.05% tokens) when beam-diversity high. Fixable by simple overlap check; also saw slight length bias for completions > 700 tokens.

Sara: did you try a conservative gate to recover quality?

Morgan: yes. gate=1.8 reduced quality hit to -0.2 LAMBADA but latency gains shrink to ~12% p50. tradeoff looks tunable.

Jun: can we run a cohort with per-example rollbacks (detect after decode)?

Morgan: planned. Next run: per-example entropy-check at window 8, rollback if avg token surprise > 3.5. kicking off tonight. tagging @ops-bot for infra.

ops-bot: deploy: scheduled shadow job on spot-pool-az3 at 03:15 UTC. job id: shadow-7712349999-01

Sara: add a small manual eval set (5 dialogues) for safety review. Also add quality monitors on prompt classes that include math and factual updates.

Morgan: adding. putting results in the spec-decode/scratch S3 path and will post links when done.

Eli: reminder — include quantization bit-width trace in metrics (per-layer 4/8 split). earlier runs hid a 2-layer 8-bit hotspot.

Morgan: good call. will include layer-wise perf and a quick ablation comparing K=16 vs K=32 for entropy.

Jun: thanks — looks actionable. if rollback plan passes, we can try canary on dedicated pool next week.

Sara: :thumbsup:
